p1.text: You are an apprentice word wizard. In your world, a word said with meaning is a spell.

p2.text: Tonight you stand in an old courtyard in Saint Petersburg, Russia. The lamps are dark. The windows are cold.

p3.text: A curse called the Silence has stolen this courtyard's words. Where the words went, everything froze.

p4.text: Learn Russian words from the people here. Cast them as spells to wake the courtyard, and open the gate to the city.

p5.text: You are not alone. Meet Eeskra, a spark of living language. She will be your guide.
